answer: Reaching eligibility takes 85 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The nebula register is checked at draw time, cipher lists the eligible set, and fable seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 85 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
